# Custom CUDA kernel definitions for matrix multiplication (naive but functional).
# We'll embed them directly in the Python code using load_inline.

matmul_cpp_source = (
    "torch::Tensor matmul_cuda(torch::Tensor A, torch::Tensor B);"

matmul_cuda_source = """
__global__ void matmul_kernel(const float* A, const float* B, float* C, int rows, int cols) {
    int row = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
    int col = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (row < rows && col < cols) {
        float sum = 0.0f;
        for (int k = 0; k < rows; ++k) { // Assuming square matrices N x N
            sum += A[row * rows + k] * B[k * rows + col];
        }
        C[row * cols + col] = sum;
    }
}

torch::Tensor matmul_cuda(torch::Tensor A, torch::Tensor B) {
    auto size = A.numel();
    auto out = torch::zeros_like(A);

    const int N = A.size(0);
    const int BLOCK_SIZE = 256;
    const int num_blocks_x = (N + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE;
    const int num_blocks_y = (N + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE;

    matmul_kernel<<<num_blocks_x, BLOCK_SIZE, num_blocks_y, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
        A.data_ptr<float>(),
        B.data_ptr<float>(),
        out.data_ptr<float>(),
        N,
        N
    );

    return out;
}
"""

elementwise_add_cpp_source = (

elementwise_add_cuda_source = """
__global__ void elementwise_add_kernel(const float* a, const float* b, float* out, int size) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < size) {
        out[idx] = a[idx] + b[idx];
    }
}

torch::Tensor elementwise_add_cuda(torch::Tensor a, torch::Tensor b) {
    auto size = a.numel();
    auto out = torch::zeros_like(a);

    const int block_size = 256;
    const int num_blocks = (size + block_size - 1) / block_size;

    elementwise_add_kernel<<<num_blocks, block_size>>>(a.data_ptr<float>(), b.data_ptr<float>(), out.data_ptr<float>(), size);

    return out;
}
